## Why This Is Asked

The scenario probes expertise in real‑time audio in RN, native bridges, and device constraints. It tests knowledge of end‑to‑end latency, threading, backpressure, and platform specifics (AudioUnit/AVAudioEngine, AVAudioSession, Bluetooth routing).

